observations: Photo 0 shows a used complete car engine assembly with a black plastic intake cover, rubber hoses, wiring harness, and multi-colored wires.
A watermark reading "FAMOUS AUTO PARTS" is visible across the center of the photo.
No brand badge, model plate, VIN, or engine code is readable on the engine itself.
The engine appears removed from a vehicle and is photographed outdoors on a paved surface.

claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star service
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; no service record or proof in the photo.

risks.risk: The engine may not run or may have internal mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting, idling, and revving, or a compression test result.

risks.risk: The engine may be incomplete or missing sensors, manifolds, or ancillaries.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all sides of the engine and a written list of included parts.

risks.risk: The engine may not fit the buyer's vehicle because its make, model, and year are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of any identification plate or stamped engine code.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any engine identification plate or stamped code
Video of the engine starting and running
Photos showing the engine from all angles to confirm completeness
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a complete car engine from the photo, so it can be priced at its worst case using comparable engine adverts even though the specific model is unreadable.
